description: This file contains selectors for managing draft messages in the Mattermost web application, including functions to retrieve drafts by prefix, get all drafts, count drafts, and fetch specific drafts based on channel and root IDs.

methods.name: makeGetDraftsByPrefix
methods.description: Creates a selector to retrieve drafts with a specific prefix from storage.

methods.name: makeGetDrafts
methods.description: Creates a selector to retrieve all local drafts, optionally filtering out inactive channels.

methods.name: makeGetDraftsCount
methods.description: Creates a selector to count the number of drafts in active channels.

methods.name: makeGetDraft
methods.description: Creates a selector to retrieve a specific draft for a given channel and root ID.

methods.name: getDraftRemotes
methods.description: Retrieves remote draft data from the state.
